description_en: Queries the binding details of a phone number. Retrieves information such as the binding relationship status, extension number, recording status, and ASR status
description_zh: 查询号码的绑定详情。获取号码绑定关系状态、分机号码、是否录音、ASR状态等信息
name: QuerySubscriptionDetail

parameters.help_en:
The key of the number pool.

Log on to the privacy protection console and go to the Number Pool Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m) page to obtain the Number Pool Key.

This parameter is required when ProductType is left empty
parameters.help_zh:
号码池Key。

在号码隐私保护控制台，号码池管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number-pool?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.7e6449bbtiHP8m)页面获取号码池Key。

当ProductType为空时必填
parameters.name: pool_key

parameters.help_en:
The product type. Valid values:
AXB_170
AXN_170
AXN_95
AXN_EXTENSION_REUSE

This parameter is applicable to former Alibaba Dayu users. Alibaba Cloud users can ignore this parameter.
This parameter is required when PoolKey is left empty
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。取值：
AXB_170。
AXN_170。
AXN_95。
AXN_EXTENSION_REUSE。

适用于原阿里大于客户，阿里云用户可忽略。
当PoolKey为空时必填
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en:
The binding relationship ID.

Logon to the privacy protection console, go to the Number Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list) page, filter the numbers, and click Details to view the binding relationship ID. Alternatively, check the SubsId in the response parameters when you invoke number binding API operations such as BindAxb (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-bindaxb).

When specifying the binding relationship ID, make sure it is associated with the PhoneNoX parameter
parameters.help_zh:
绑定关系ID。

请登录号码隐私保护控制台，在号码管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list)页面筛选号码，点击详情查看号码的绑定关系ID，或者在调用BindAxb (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-bindaxb?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a807e38uud6C5)等号码绑定API时查看返回参数中的SubsId。

在填写绑定关系ID时，注意填写与PhoneNoX参数关联的绑定关系ID
parameters.name: subs_id

parameters.help_en:
The privacy number in the binding relationship, which is the X number.

Logon to the privacy protection console and go to the Number Management (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list) page to obtain the X number. Alternatively, check the SecretNo in the response parameters when you invoke number binding API operations such as BindAxb (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-bindaxb).

When specifying the X number, make sure it is associated with the SubsId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
绑定关系中的隐私号码，即X号码。

请登录号码隐私保护控制台，在号码管理 (https://dyplsnext.console.aliyun.com/number/list)页面获取X号码，或者在调用BindAxb (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/pnp/developer-reference/api-dyplsapi-2017-05-25-bindaxb?spm=a2c4g.11186623.0.0.6a807e38uud6C5)等号码绑定接口时查看返回参数中的SecretNo。

在填写X号码时，注意填写与SubsId参数关联的X号码
parameters.name: phone_nox

Code.description_en:
The request status code.
OK indicates that the request was successful.
For other error codes, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）
Code.description_zh:
请求状态码。
返回OK代表请求成功。
其他错误码详见[错误码列表]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/109196.html）

Message.description_en: The description of the status code

SecretBindDetailDTO.description_en: The data structure returned when the API call is successful
SecretBindDetailDTO.description_zh: 接口调用成功后返回的结构体

ASRModelId.description_en:
The ASR model ID. Valid values:

General-Telephone-Mandarin Chinese model ID: 7ee372834d2f4cc7ac0d0ab2d0ae1aac

General-Telephone-Cantonese Chinese model ID: 9b4afe3d224e4fa3bf963697113e2f77

General-Telephone-Regional Accent model ID: 3655a6cb94764145a1f9a38a3c3b3b4b
ASRModelId.description_zh:
ASR模型ID。取值：

通用-电话-中文普通话模型 ID：7ee372834d2f4cc7ac0d0ab2d0ae1aac

通用-电话-中文粤语模型 ID：9b4afe3d224e4fa3bf963697113e2f77

通用-电话-地方口音模型 ID：3655a6cb94764145a1f9a38a3c3b3b4b

ASRStatus.description_en:
The Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) status. Valid values:

false: Disabled.
true: Enabled
ASRStatus.description_zh:
ASR状态。取值：

false：关闭
true：开启

CallRestrict.description_en:
The one-way call restriction status. This parameter is not returned if no one-way call restriction is configured. Valid values:
CONTROL_AX_DISABLE: Phone number A cannot call phone number X.
CONTROL_BX_DISABLE: Phone number B cannot call phone number X
CallRestrict.description_zh:
单通呼叫限制的状态。如果没有设置单通呼叫限制，则不返回该参数。取值：
CONTROL_AX_DISABLE：A号码无法呼叫X号码。
CONTROL_BX_DISABLE：B号码无法呼叫X号码

ExpireDate.description_en: The expiration time of the binding relationship, in the format of YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss
ExpireDate.description_zh: 绑定关系的过期时间，格式为 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss

Extension.description_en: The extension number in the AXG extension binding

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the binding relationship was created

GroupId.description_en: The ID of the number group G (GID) in the binding relationship
GroupId.description_zh: 绑定关系中的G号码组ID，即GID

NeedRecord.description_en:
Indicates whether all calls generated by this binding relationship are recorded. Valid values:
false: Calls are not recorded.
true: Calls are recorded
NeedRecord.description_zh:
是否对该绑定关系产生的所有通话，进行通话录音。取值：
false：不录音
true：录音

PhoneNoA.description_en: The phone number A in the binding relationship

PhoneNoB.description_en: The phone number B in the binding relationship

PhoneNoX.description_en: The private number in the binding relationship, which is the X number
PhoneNoX.description_zh: 绑定关系中的隐私号码，即X号码

Status.description_en:
The status of the binding relationship. Valid values:
0: Expired.
1: Active
Status.description_zh:
该绑定关系的状态。取值：
0：已失效。
1：生效中
